Recorded claim:
`CalendarEventCreateEditDialog` appends `calendarEventCreateEditDialogTemplate` directly into the dialog and does not attach a shadow root. Bare `<slot>` elements in `calendarEventCreateEditDialogTemplate.inc.xhtml` therefore do not distribute light-DOM children: a child with `slot="calendar-name"` had `assignedSlot === null`. [Task 1]
